messages:
maria-sec: Heads-up — we just triaged CVE‑2026‑XXXX affecting glibc 2.36 on Ubuntu 22.04 and the OpenSSL shim on our minimal images. Impact: container runtime heap corruption if fed specially crafted cert data.
kevin-sre: Thanks. Do we have a quick vuln matrix: which images (ubuntu:22.04 vs alpine:3.18), which services use them, and whether musl builds are affected?
sanjay-ml: alpine (musl) is not impacted by the glibc CVE but the OpenSSL shim we vendor into the slim image is. Ubuntu images need glibc patch + libssl update. I can list services using the ubuntu base in the next hour.
maria-sec: Action items I'm proposing: 1) trigger rebuilds for ubuntu:22.04-derived images with patched glibc/libssl, 2) rotate the image signing key to a KMS‑backed key and re-sign artifacts, 3) add an RBAC role for the rebuild pipeline so only deployer service accounts can sign, and 4) schedule canary rollout + audit logging.
olivia-devex: For (2) — we should use cosign with our KMS key alias so private keys never touch CI. Example for GCP KMS:
```
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/proj/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/cosign-key-2026 gcr.io/myorg/app:tag
```
That should integrate with our existing deploy pipeline.
kevin-sre: RBAC note: the pipeline SA needs iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on the cosign signer role? Also we need to limit which SA can call KMS for signing. Proposed Kubernetes role:
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: image-signer
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get"]
```
But main restriction is on the cloud IAM side — give the pipeline SA a dedicated role `roles/kms.signerVerifier` scoped to the cosign key.
maria-sec: Good. Also add audit log sink for all `cosign sign` actions and container registry pushes. We need to retain logs for 13 months for compliance.
sanjay-ml: Canary plan: push rebuilt images to `gcr.io/myorg/canary/*` tags, schedule a progressive rollout: 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 6 hours, with automated rollback on error rate > 0.5% or latency p50 regressions. Canary checker will use existing smoke tests + cert parsing fuzz test that reproduces the exploit vector.
olivia-devex: Who owns verifying the cosign + KMS integration? I can take ownership of CI pipeline changes but need cloud IAM ticket and test key.
maria-sec: @olivia-devex please file an infra ticket assigning `infra-iam` to create a KMS key with key rotation enabled and grant `roles/kms.signerVerifier` to `ci-image-signer@myorg.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Also create a short-lived test key for dev verification.
kevin-sre: I'll own canary rollout orchestration and add audit dashboards (logs -> BigQuery -> Grafana).
sanjay-ml: I'll produce the list of affected services and a quick-risk ranking (P0/P1/P2) by EOD.
maria-sec: Cool. Final checklist before we run rebuilds:
- infra ticket for KMS key + IAM (olivia)
- CI changes to use cosign KMS (olivia)
- RBAC role change PR for rebuild pipeline (maria-kevin)
- Rebuild job + push to canary registry (sanjay)
- Canary jobs + smoke/fuzz tests (kevin-sre)
- Audit log retention policy + dashboards (kevin-sre)
Please update PR links here as you create them.
deploy-bot: CI pipeline triggered: rebuild-ubuntu-images-1862345699 started (job id: rebuild-1862). Logs: https://ci.internal/rebuild/1862 :gear: 
maria-sec: Thanks all, let's do a quick sync in #eng-security in 30min if anyone hits blockers. :eyes:
